mic.title: Microphone
mic.intro: Pick your microphone and speakers. The defaults usually work.
mic.idle: Press Test, say something, and you will hear yourself back.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.noTelemetry: Mumcord sends no telemetry, analytics or crash reports.
privacy.ownServers: It connects only to the servers you add.
privacy.linkPreviews: Link previews and images or GIFs from chat links are loaded from the linked sites. You can turn this off in the next step or later in Settings.
privacy.mumcordUsers: Mumcord-only features exchange data only with other Mumcord users on the same server.
privacy.local: Everything Mumcord stores stays on your computer.

updates.title: New versions
updates.hint: Once a day Mumcord asks GitHub whether a newer version exists and shows a hint with a link. Nothing is downloaded or installed, and nothing is sent except the request itself and the app name and version. You can change this later in Settings.

talk.title: How do you want to talk?
talk.voiceActivationHint: Your microphone turns on when you speak.
talk.pushToTalkHint: Hold a key while you speak.
talk.waylandNoPortal: Push to talk isn't available: your desktop doesn't let apps use global shortcuts. Voice activation works without a key.
talk.registrationFailed: Push to talk couldn't be set up on this system. Use voice activation instead.
talk.confirmDialog: Confirm the shortcut in the system dialog or assign it in the System Settings window that opens… (Escape to cancel)
talk.keyInvalid: That key can't be used. Try another one.
talk.keyNotConfirmed: The desktop didn't confirm the shortcut. Try again and accept the system dialog, or assign the key in the desktop's shortcut settings.
talk.keyRequired: Choose a push-to-talk key or switch to voice activation.
talk.linkHandlerHint: Clicking a server link on a website then opens it here.
talk.linkHandlerFailed: Mumcord could not be set up to open mumble:// links. You can try again in Settings.
talk.mouseDisabled: Push to talk isn't available with this mouse button until "Allow mouse buttons" is switched on in Settings → Voice.
talk.mouseNeedsInputGroup: Push to talk isn't available: Mumcord may not read your mouse. Settings → Voice explains how to allow it.
talk.mouseNeedsAccessibility: Push to talk isn't available: Mumcord needs the Accessibility permission to see mouse buttons.
talk.pressKeyOrMouse: Press a key or a mouse button (middle or side)… (Escape to cancel)
talk.mouseStillWorks: You can still use a mouse button.
talk.mouseOptIn: Want to use a mouse side button? Switch on "Allow mouse buttons" in Settings → Voice after setup.
talk.autostart: Start Mumcord when I log in
talk.autostartHint: You can change this later in Settings → Appearance.
talk.autostartFailed: Mumcord could not be set to start when you log in. You can try again in Settings.
talk.linkPreviewsHint: Mumcord loads linked pages to show previews and video players; those sites see your IP address.
talk.historySharingHint: Other Mumcord users who join a channel after you can see its earlier messages from your saved history (up to 7 days). Private chats are never shared. You can change this later in Settings → Chat & history.
talk.ingameOverlayHint: Draws who is talking on top of your game (Linux). You can turn it on or off per game later in Settings.
talk.ingameOverlayWarning: Some games with anti-cheat may flag or block in-game overlays. Mumcord keeps known-risky games (such as Valorant or League of Legends) off by default. Enable it only for games you trust.
